notes: Fixed label sets. run.py merge warns on (and files as 'Other') any label not listed here, so the dashboard's groups stay clean week to week. Classify by the BRAND/CLIENT's industry, not the agency's (e.g. 'YAAP wins Narayana Health' → Healthcare & Pharma). Add a label here first if a genuinely new industry keeps showing up.

industry_guide.Food, Beverage & FMCG: packaged food, soft drinks, alcobev, QSR, home care/detergents, pet food, nutrition
industry_guide.Beauty & Personal Care: cosmetics, skincare, haircare, soaps, hygiene, fragrance, grooming
industry_guide.Fashion & Jewellery: apparel, footwear, sportswear, eyewear, jewellery, luxury
industry_guide.E-commerce & Quick Commerce: Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, AJIO, Zepto, Blinkit, Swiggy/Instamart, Zomato
industry_guide.BFSI & Fintech: banks, NBFCs, insurance (incl. health insurance), mutual funds, payments, crypto
industry_guide.Auto & Mobility: cars, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, lubricants, tyres, auto parts
industry_guide.Tech, Telecom & Electronics: telcos, smartphones, consumer electronics, software, AI products, IT services
industry_guide.Home & Durables: appliances, paints, furniture, kitchenware, electricals, home textiles
industry_guide.Real Estate & Building Materials: developers, cement, steel, plywood, construction equipment
industry_guide.Media, Entertainment & Sports: broadcasters, OTT, publishers, film releases, leagues, sports bodies
industry_guide.Travel & Hospitality: airlines, hotels, theme parks, travel platforms
industry_guide.Energy & Industrial: power, solar, EV charging, conglomerate corporate campaigns, packaging/industrial
industry_guide.Adtech, Agencies & Regulation: agency-network news, ad platforms/adtech, ASCI/SEBI/MIB ad rules

experience_guide.Concerts & Live Shows: music tours, stand-up comedy tours, residencies, one-off gigs — incl. presenting sponsors and ticketing partners
experience_guide.Film & Entertainment Launches: film releases and box office, trailer/teaser launch events, fan screenings, series premieres, theatrical-experience formats
experience_guide.Sports & Endurance: HYROX, marathons/half-marathons, triathlons, Ironman, cyclothons, mass-participation fitness, title events and leagues as live experiences
experience_guide.Festivals & Culture: music festivals (Lollapalooza, NH7, Sunburn, Echoes of Earth), Durga Puja/Ganesh/Diwali-scale cultural moments, food & art festivals
experience_guide.Brand Experiences & IPs: brand-owned events and IPs, pop-ups, immersive activations, brand-led festivals (e.g. Zomaland, Red Bull, Bacardi NH7)
experience_guide.Ticketing, Venues & Policy: BookMyShow/District/thumpN moves, venue launches, live-events policy, industry data, promoter business news (Live Nation etc.)
